issue: CODE-554 cloud half: emergency signing channel client handoff

endpoint.boundary: The emergency document is served from a dedicated origin and Cloudflare Pages project with its own credential and signing keyring. It shares nothing with the normal configuration channel except the contract rules in CONTRACT.md. A normal-channel outage must not affect this endpoint.
endpoint.targetScope: Emergency state is channel-neutral and bound to exactly (brandId, platform). Clients must reject a document whose brandId or platform differs from the requested target.

keys.note: Test keyring only (public RFC 8032 conformance seed). Production emergency public keys ship inside the client via the CODE-552 generated keyring and are never fetched at runtime.

antiReplayCases.name: equal version with different payload is equivocation

semantics.monotonicVersion: emergencyVersion is a canonical uint64 decimal string compared numerically. Persist the high-water mark and the complete accepted document once signature, target, and monotonic checks pass. Never accept a lower version; accept an equal version only for byte-identical payloads.
semantics.disabledFeatures: Every listed known feature key is forced to boolean false after overrides and rollouts, regardless of apply mode. Unknown keys are ignored. An empty array explicitly clears the effect.
semantics.forceMinVersionSticky: forceMinVersion persists until a strictly newer accepted signed document explicitly carries forceMinVersion null. LinkCode Cloud only signs such a clearing document through an explicit release publication approved by two people; clients simply apply the newest accepted document in full.
semantics.notice: notice is { title, body, url } or null. null explicitly clears it. Render it verbatim; the URL is HTTPS or null.
semantics.failOpen: Network, parse, unknown-key, signature, replay, and equivocation failures are fail-open for startup: retain the last accepted emergency state and continue. There is no implicit expiry; local time is never used for freshness.
semantics.releaseRehearsal: The release document above clears disabledFeatures, forceMinVersion, and notice in one strictly newer publication. Clients need no rehearsal-specific behavior: a rehearsal is an ordinary publish followed by an ordinary release.

api.note: Operator-facing control plane of LinkCode Cloud. Clients never call these endpoints; they are frozen here so the desktop and mobile halves can rely on the operational semantics.

request.reason: Disable the assistant while the incident is investigated.

approve.rule: The approver must be a different person than the requester; self-approval and duplicate approval are rejected. Approval requires the emergency action grant for the request's brand.

publish.rule: Each distinct Idempotency-Key allocates the next emergencyVersion for the target; retrying the same key returns the same publication. An approved request may be published repeatedly for rehearsals.

cloudControlPlane.versionAllocation: emergencyVersion is allocated by the control plane under a per-target lock, strictly increasing per (brandId, platform). A CLI fallback publication is reconciled afterwards by raising the allocator floor with an audited reconciliation record; the allocator never decreases.
cloudControlPlane.cliFallback: The emergency CLI publishes without the LinkCode Cloud API, database, normal publication runner, or normal Pages credential. It uses the emergency signing key, a sealed local monotonic state, two distinct recorded human identities, and writes an auditable evidence file.
